class.name: RenderDataRD
class.brief_description: Render data implementation for the RenderingDevice based renderers.
class.description: This object manages all render data for the [RenderingDevice]-based renderers. See also [RenderData], [RenderSceneData], and [RenderSceneDataRD]. [b]Note:[/b] This is an internal rendering server object. Do not instantiate this class from a script.

method.name: get_directional_light_buffer
method.description: Returns the borrowed uniform buffer containing current Forward+ directional-light data. It is only valid during compositor callbacks after opaque rendering and must not be freed.

method.name: get_directional_light_count
method.description: Returns the number of current Forward+ directional lights available during this render callback.

method.name: get_directional_shadow_atlas_texture
method.description: Returns the borrowed current Forward+ directional shadow atlas texture, or an invalid [RID] when no directional shadows are active. It is only valid during compositor callbacks after opaque rendering and must not be freed.

method.name: get_omni_light_buffer
method.description: Returns the borrowed storage buffer containing current Forward+ omni-light data. It is only valid during compositor callbacks after opaque rendering and must not be freed.

method.name: get_omni_light_count
method.description: Returns the number of current Forward+ omni lights in [method get_omni_light_buffer].

method.name: get_shadow_atlas_texture
method.description: Returns the borrowed current Forward+ positional-light shadow atlas texture, or an invalid [RID] when no atlas is available. It must not be freed.

method.name: get_spot_light_buffer
method.description: Returns the borrowed storage buffer containing current Forward+ spot-light data. It is only valid during compositor callbacks after opaque rendering and must not be freed.

method.name: get_spot_light_count
method.description: Returns the number of current Forward+ spot lights in [method get_spot_light_buffer].
